paraphrase: Speech is the consecration; one is consecrated by speech; the breath is the consecrated. By speech as consecration and breath as the consecrated, the gods grasped all desires on both sides and placed them in themselves.

paraphrase: Speech is Pathyā Svasti; she recognized the northern quarter. Therefore in the north speech is spoken most distinctly, and people go north to learn speech; whoever comes from there, they listen to him.
